# World Cup Elo (worldcupelo.com)

> Live Elo ratings for every men's national football team, built for the road to the 2026 World Cup.

World Cup Elo gives every men's national team a single continuous rating computed from match results, opponent strength, and home advantage, using the World Football Elo methodology (logistic expected score, tournament-weighted K, roughly +60 home advantage, goal-difference weighting). Ratings are grounded in the publicly published World Football Elo Ratings (eloratings.net).

It is for football fans, analysts, and bettors who want an honest, transparent ranking and head-to-head win probabilities. The site pairs a global rankings table with per-team pages, a match predictor, and a 2026 World Cup hub covering hosts, favorites, and confederation contenders. There are also open JSON endpoints (no key required) so agents can read the same data.

## Key links
- [Home](https://worldcupelo.com/): live global rankings table, today's World Cup fixtures, and confederation leaders.
- [Rankings](https://worldcupelo.com/rankings): full ranked list of men's national teams by live Elo, filterable by confederation.
- [World Cup 2026](https://worldcupelo.com/world-cup-2026): tournament hub with hosts, favorites, and group standings.
- [Predict](https://worldcupelo.com/predict): head-to-head match prediction with win/draw/loss probabilities and a home-advantage toggle.
- [Methodology](https://worldcupelo.com/methodology): how the Elo engine works and where the data comes from.
- [Rankings API](https://worldcupelo.com/api/rankings): JSON endpoint; also /api/team/[code] and /api/match/[team1]/[team2].
